title: equisetum laevigatum f. polystachum
intro: Equisetum laevigatum f. polystachum, commonly known as Rough Horsetail, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include supporting kidney function, reducing inflammation, and aiding in the treatment of urinary tract issues due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate urine production, reduce pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Equisetum laevigatum f. polystachum include flavonoids, lignans, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
